scope: 42 prepared-only Deep Learning packets; no runtime publication
userRequirement: No learner prediction feature, even optionally. Live controls show the current mechanism and output immediately.

checks.semanticReview: Removed lab prediction/commit/grading/reveal contracts and reviewed remaining prediction/gate wording as subject matter, independent practice, process chronology or explicitly superseded historical authoring notes.
limitations: No React implementation or publication for these packets.
No new experiment, numeric campaign or independent scientific re-review.
No browser/render/accessibility validation for unimplemented visuals.
Policy compliance is a reviewed authoring contract, not proof of a future implementation.
